# J & K Transmission Specialist Pte Ltd

> Gearbox and automatic transmission specialist workshop in Jurong West, Singapore.

- Address: 1 Corporation Drive @ REVV, #02-03, Singapore 619775
- Hours: Monday to Friday 9:00am to 6:00pm; Saturday 9:00am to 3:00pm; Sunday and public holidays Closed

## Services
- Gearbox overhaul & repair
- Double-clutch (DCT) repair & replacement
- Reconditioned mechatronics & solenoid replacement
- TCU / TCM repair & programming
- Valve body servicing
- Torque converter repair
- Flywheel & pulley chain replacement
- Wear-and-tear transmission parts
- Transmission fluid (ATF / DCTF) & engine oil servicing
